confidence_notes: June 2026 Numbeo restaurant prices and July 2026 Expatistan prices provide recent reference points. Expatistan warns that its Mombasa data use fewer than ten prices; wine is estimated from its relationship to local draft beer. Accommodation anchors are holistic estimates.
comparable_city_reasoning: Mombasa is a major coastal tourism city. I placed basic rooms near Nairobi and Zanzibar, three-star rooms slightly above Nairobi and Zanzibar, and hostel prices near the lower end of the supplied coastal-city comparisons.
